commands.name: url

commands.name: slug

commands.name: hash
commands.summary: Hash files, text, or stdin

commands.name: repos

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Add the standard starter files to a project

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Check that this machine is ready for a project, and install what is missing

commands.name: port
commands.summary: Show what is listening on a port, and stop it

commands.name: ip
commands.summary: Show this machine's local IP addresses

commands.name: serve
commands.summary: Serve a folder over HTTP

commands.name: clip
commands.summary: Copy text or stdin to the clipboard

commands.name: paste
commands.summary: Print the clipboard

commands.name: config
commands.summary: Show, create, or edit your zx config

commands.name: ai

commands.name: new
commands.summary: Create a command: describe it and the AI writes it, or name it to scaffold Go
commands.usage: zx new "<what it should do>" | zx new <name> [flags]
examples: zx new "bump the version, update the readme, tag the repo"
zx new dice -s "Roll some dice" -g Generate
